g.title: configuration
g.text: Model configuration ownership — current / failed resume

g.title: lock
g.text: core: native + send lock, goal protection

g.title: effect_guard
g.text: Persist possible before every native mutation

g.title: sideeffect
g.text: Codex: before final effort key / Enter

g.title: reconcile
g.text: No input / no current settings inspection

g.title: receipt
g.text: Any issued input => unconfirmed, even on success

g.title: result
g.text: core: preserve metadata / goal / defaults ordering
Return same public result or exception

g.title: port
g.text: read screen / submit complete command / menu keys
Existing ready or text wait supplied by core

g.title: codex
g.text: Open picker -> preserve current effort if needed
Resolve missing model only on existing fallback

g.title: failure
g.text: Existing bounded Esc cleanup; no resend

g.title: preview
g.text: Cancel without save; missing / mismatch => null

g.title: preview->failure
g.text: unknown / other thread / fast / no ready

g.title: restore_resume
g.text: Confirmed goal only / pause / turn-end / owned resume

g.title: preview->restore_resume
g.text: same thread; known model / effort mismatch

g.title: repair
g.text: Owns native pin / composer gate / admission

g.title: restore_resume->failure
g.text: goal unavailable / unsupported / missing readback: no settings or body
